name: zimlo
description: Structured Agent-authored reading cards and action checkpoints for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Publish structured, readable coding checkpoints to your local Feed.
interface.longDescription: Adds the Zimlo Feed V2 protocol, structured reading-card tools, and lifecycle checkpoints to Codex GUI tasks. Agents edit conclusions, impact, evidence, and next actions explicitly; raw prompts stay in Task details.
defaultPrompt: Start this coding task and keep Zimlo updated at meaningful checkpoints.
Post the current result to my Zimlo Feed.
Explain what is blocking this task and ask me through Zimlo.
